title: Key West Craft Cocktail Experience
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
20% Gratuity included in the ticket price
All participants must be 21 and over
Pets and emotional support animals are not allowed
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the lively world of craft cocktails in a unique 1.5-hour session at Key West's oldest brick building. Get your hands on authentic bar tools to create two cocktails, while also sampling three others. Delight in tasty bites as you soak in tales of local legends like William Curry and the charming history that shaped this island paradise. With expert bartenders guiding you, this hands-on experience is perfect for anyone looking to mix it up while learning about Key West's vibrant past. Plus, take home some fun SWAG as a memento.
